verdicts.reason: Both use the same decent left-to-right banner structure: the quote mark and headline sit together on the left with the attribution under them. Both have the same flaw: the brand logo floats in the middle gap with no alignment to anything and reads like stray debris. A's can is larger and fills its circle, so the product and its SOLSTICE label stay legible, though the sun icon is jammed against the circle's top edge. B shrinks the can to a tiny figure inside a big empty circle, which makes the label unreadable and weakens the product.
